scenes.text: Could Dayot Upamecano have stopped Hitler from conquering France?
Dayot Upamecano. {{best}}One of the best centre backs in the world. {{really}}Genuinely. {{calm}}Famous for his calm, error free defending. ||0.4|| {{wink}}Mostly.
May {1940|nineteen forty}: {{men}}three million soldiers {{tanks}}and two and a half thousand tanks, {{ard}}coming through the Ardennes.
He holds a perfect high line {{line}}across the whole forest. {{tank}}A twenty tonne tank? {{slide}}Sliding tackle. {{clean}}All ball. ||0.3|| {{off}}Three million soldiers: offside.

So yes, {{yes}}he stops them. ||0.3|| {{risk}}Then, under no pressure at all, he tries one simple pass. ||0.3|| {{walk}}The whole army walks past him. ||0.3|| {{like}}Even the tanks left a like. {{loop}}So next time someone asks you:
